notes.title: Update v1.3!!
notes.content:
update v1.3
-IA improvements and minor bugs corrections
-Space used in Hard drive reduced.
-Minor changes to bosses from stages 1 and 5

-Next update soon!

-Stages 1 and 2 layout adjustment 
-no more input lag in menus
